title: Ledger
description: The completeness record of a review: one row per rule probed, naming what was opened and the verdict reached. A probe subagent returns the rows for its group, the reviewing context merges them, and the whole ledger travels with the review. A row is complete only with its examined and evidence filled; a statement that a rule was considered is not a row

rows.evidence: Both scripts run under set -euo pipefail, and no step is wrapped in a construct that would let the script continue.

headCommit.description: The commit every row was reached against

Examined.description: What was actually opened to reach the verdict: files, symbols, call sites, test files including the case where none exist, and for a search every query used. Context the probe needed and could not obtain is named here rather than silently dropped

Row.description: One probe's result; the verdict decides what the row carries

ViolationRow.description: The rule is violated: evidence names file and line inside the surface, and every finding is carried as a violation

CleanRow.description: The rule holds: evidence names what was checked that would have exposed a violation; it carries no violations

NotApplicableRow.description: The rule cannot apply to the full context: evidence says why. No findings is not a reason; it carries no violations
